$comment: Every test data file outside git: three images and two FITS files under tests/testdata/large/, git-ignored, copied by hand from E:/Photografie/Claude (ADR 0005); IVC_TESTDATA_LARGE may name another folder, nobody sets it. Paths are relative to that folder. scripts/check-testdata.ps1 verifies presence and SHA-256 (a missing large file is a warning locally); -Update rewrites this file with PowerShell JSON layout. The cases in docs/validation.json name these files. ImageVisualCompare has no repo fixtures: TempImages writes them at run time.

files.name: de_printat.png
files.source: the owner's finished Milky Way core, 5938 x 3888, 16-bit RGB PNG (Rgb48), exported from Siril 2026-08-30; image A of both cases
files.demonstrates: docs/validation.json V-001, V-002: a 16-bit PNG probed and decoded; R-010, R-011, R-013

files.name: de_printat_PRINT_preview_16bit.tif
files.source: the same frame after the print-preview stretch, 5938 x 3888, 16-bit RGB TIFF (Rgb48), 2026-09-20; image B of V-001
files.demonstrates: docs/validation.json V-001: a matched pair, PNG against TIFF, no padding; R-007

files.name: de_printat_50x35_TIFF8.tif
files.source: the same frame cropped to 50:35 and exported as 8-bit TIFF (Bgr24), 5554 x 3888, 2026-09-19; image B of V-002
files.demonstrates: docs/validation.json V-002: a mismatched pair, 16-bit against 8-bit, padded to 5938 x 3888; R-003, R-004, R-012

files.name: result_3813s.fit
files.source: the linear stack the frame was processed from, 5938 x 3888, three planes of 32-bit float in 0 to 1, ROWORDER BOTTOM-UP, written by Siril 1.4.4 on 2026-08-30; copied from E:/Photografie/Claude/Processed_WithFlats_RBF_light; image A of V-003 and V-004
files.demonstrates: docs/validation.json V-003, V-004: a float FITS probed and decoded by the project's own reader; R-014, R-015, R-018

files.name: result_3813s_Graxpert_AI.fit
files.source: the same stack after GraXpert's background extraction, 5938 x 3888, three planes of 32-bit float, saved by Siril 1.4.4 on 2026-08-30; same folder; image B of V-003
files.demonstrates: docs/validation.json V-003: a matched pair of two FITS files, no padding; R-014
